The Company

˚MEQU is a Danish MedTech company behind the ˚M Warmer System, an innovative medical device that enables healthcare professionals to deliver warm blood and IV-fluids from the point of injury to the hospital. With customers across military, tactical, emergency, HEMS, and hospital environments worldwide, our ambition is to become the global leader in blood and IV-fluid warming solutions for pre-hospital and through hospital care. Learn more about ˚MEQU: www.mequ.dk

On behalf of ˚MEQU, Best Talent is recruiting an International Product Manager.

The Team

You will join a small, ambitious Marketing team with ambitious plans and great impact on the future growth of the company. Success is driven by close collaboration across Marketing, R&D, QA/RA, Operations, and Commercial functions in a fast moving and highly cross-functional environment.

International Product Manager

Drive global product strategy for an innovative Danish MedTech company

• Shape life-saving MedTech solutions through your clinical expertise

• Collaborate with leading healthcare providers, emergency services, and military organizations

• Play a key role in the international growth of a fast-scaling Danish MedTech company with a meaningful and global purpose

The Role

We are looking for an International Product Manager who can bridge clinical insights, users’ needs, regulatory requirements, and technical development to drive successful global product strategies and commercial execution.

You will own the global product lifecycle across emergency, tactical, and hospital segments. With the United States representing ˚MEQU’s most important growth market, you will play a key role in ensuring that product positioning, roadmap priorities, and value propositions algin with the clinical, regulatory, and commercial requirements of US military, EMS, HEMS, and hospital customers.

Working across the organization, you will ensure that user insights, market needs, engineering priorities and regulatory considerations are translated into clear product direction and commercially viable solutions.

As the internal subject-matter expert within pre-hospital blood and IV transfusion, you will convert clinical challenges into prioritized product requirements that guide product development and long-term portfolio decisions. The position reports directly to the COO and requires approximately 30-50 travel days annually.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Shaping global product positioning, value propositions, and market prioritization to support successful international expansion, and continuously monitor:

• Developments in clinical standards of care.

• Tactical and military medical protocols.

• Global procurement and reimbursement structures.

• Competitive and technological developments.

• International market dynamics and commercial opportunities.

• Develop instructions for use, training materials, user guides, and educational content to support sales teams, distributors, and clinical specialists globally.

Your professional background:

You bring a clinical background within emergency medicine, pre-hospital care, HEMS, military medicine, or tactical care, combined with hands-on experience with blood and IV transfusion in critical settings. You understand the realities and challenges faced by end users in high-pressure environments.

In addition, you have commercial insight into the MedTech industry and experience supporting product positioning, launches, and international market development. Experience working with institutional customers medical device markets and understand how to position, launch, and scale products internationally. Experience with institutional and public procurement structures is highly valued.

You understand medical device development and the regulatory environment and are able to translate complex clinical needs into structured product requirements that create both customers value and commercial impact.

Your personality – You are:

• A strong communicator with who bridges clinical technical, regulatory, and commercial perspectives.

• Commercially minded with a strategic and customer-centric approach

• Structured and analytical, with the ability to balance long-term strategy and operational execution

• Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership in a dynamic scale-up environment

• Curious, collaborative, and motivated by improving patient outcomes through innovation

˚MEQU offers you:

You will gain international exposure across tactical, emergency, and hospital markets and collaborate closely with global distributors, armed forces, and leading healthcare institutions.

• A high-impact position with global strategic product influence

• A dynamic, international, and collaborative work environment

• A diverse team of 30+ colleagues headquartered in Copenhagen

• A mission-driven culture focused on improving patient outcomes

• Competitive salary with a pension scheme and up-to-date benefits

Application:

Please send your application in English, marked ”1947/International Product Manager” to job@besttalent.dk. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Learn more about Best Talent at www.besttalent.dk.

QA Professional, Expansion QA

CMC Drug Substance QA

Manufacturing Quality

Denmark, Bagsværd

Are you looking for a job with a lot of interaction with cross functional stakeholders and close teamwork?  Are you skilled in navigating complex stakeholder landscapes and do you believe in working together is better than working on your own? Do you value good team spirit where everyone is each other's sparring partners and respect each other's opinions and knowledge? Do you also have a strong quality mind-set and great interpersonal skills and want to use all this solid QA experience in a project context. Do you like a very outgoing job with many contact surfaces then this might be the right job for you.

CMC DS QA, Expansion QA team, is looking for a new colleague to be part of projects in CMC API Pilots. The CMC API Pilot facilities are expanding their production capacity for products to clinical trials, and we are looking for a new QA colleagues to work with our QA colleagues allocated for investment projects.

We offer you a unique position with a lot of impact in a dynamic environment and an opportunity to really develop your skills professionally and personally.

Your new role

As the CMC API pilot facilities expand their production capacity for clinical trials and phase 3 manufacturing, we need additional QA Professionals to join our 8 skilled Project QA professionals, supporting expansion projects or the broader CMC API Area.

Your main responsibilities include:

• Delivering top-quality standards in facility and equipment qualification

• Reviewing and approving qualification documentation

• Participate in setting the qualification strategy for projects, e.g. by participating in workshops

• Collaborating across functions with scientists and QA colleagues

• Assessing requirements and guiding quality decisions for projects

Working closely with your peers, you'll help raise compliance levels, solve ad hoc GMP-related challenges, review and approve documentation for facility and equipment qualification as well as other relevant materials for the Pilot facilities.

Your skills and qualifications

To excel in this role, you should have a strong mindset for quality assurance and a proactive approach to managing quality concerns. Your comprehensive knowledge of pharmaceutical regulations, requirements, and guidelines enables you to navigate efficiently without unnecessary complexity.

Required qualifications:

• MSc in Pharmacy, Engineering, Biology, Chemistry, or related field

• Experienced in the QA role or production role

• Minimum 2 years of experience in qualification/validation processes based on Science and Risk based Validation (SRV) principles

• Deep understanding of GMP

• Proficiency in English

IT Quality qualification experience is a plus but not mandatory.

Personally, you are adept at multitasking, capable of making decisions and following up on quality issues and demonstrate ownership and dedication to achieving objectives and delivering outstanding results. You work independently, communicate clearly about complex topics, and take responsibility and initiative. You thrive in a fast-paced setting, value teamwork, and enjoy engaging with diverse stakeholders.

Your Team

CMC Drug Substance QA employ 37 dedicated colleagues across three teams located in Bagsværd. We ensure quality and compliance for CMC API facilities and equipment as well as the release of raw materials, cell banks, and API for clinical trials.

We participate as QA in investment projects to keep Pilot facilities future-ready, continually improving methods and processes to simplify workflows within CMC Quality and Development.

You will be part of Expansion QA team consisting of 8 QA professionals. The Team is QA responsible for the API pilot facilities assuring the quality of the facility and the Equipment during the qualification phase and before facility and equipment is released for GMP production.

Our team values teamwork, diversity, and humour and we will make sure that you, as our new employee, feel welcome and included. A thorough individual training plan will be made for you together with your mentor.

What we offer

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary:  For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 659,500.00 to 854,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

More information

For questions, contact Sr. Manager Charlotte Hellesøe Ørtoft at +45 3075 1742 or Validation Specialist Anne Rønholt at +45 3079 0638. Be advised either Charlotte or Anne will not support queries about your recruitment status.

Deadline

25th October 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Please apply in English and refrain from adding a photo to your CV to ensure fair and efficient processing. We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants. Note, that automatic screening questions are used as part of the application process for this position. We encourage you to answer these carefully, as they help us assess your expectations, experience and qualifications.

Do you want to help develop the future of automated communication solutions for utility meters? Are you ready to be challenged while gaining an exciting and educational internship experience? Do you want to contribute to real development projects?

Here is what the job entails

As an intern in Connectivity for Water solutions, you will work with a wide range of tasks within Kamstrup’s cellular and LoRa technology domain. A significant part of your work will involve supporting our development team with ongoing projects and activities.

More specifically, you will be:

• Supporting building prototypes using the latest technologies

• Working with embedded software development

• Collecting and analyzing test data for ongoing technology projects

• Exploring 4G/LTE technology primarily based on 3GPP CAT-M and NB-IoT

• Obtaining experience with LoRaWAN protocol

• Developing various scripts typically in Python

In this position you will have the opportunity to actively participate in ongoing projects in close collaboration with the other engineers and become an integrated part of the team. Your final tasks will be tailored to your competencies and interests, but you will work on real challenges that contribute to our development projects.

Meet your future team

As an intern in Connectivity for Water Solutions, you will join a strong and professional team of 12 experienced firmware engineers, dedicated to developing advanced communication technologies and maintaining the systems behind our solutions. We are always at the forefront of the latest methods in cellular solutions and embedded software. You will experience a collaborative work environment where knowledge sharing, curiosity and openness is part of everyday life, giving you great opportunities to grow professionally as well as personally.

Did you know? It is safe to say that you will work with the team in Kamstrup, that has the largest number of gadgets in the office!

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a curious and ambitious intern who wants to put theory into practice and become part of a strong development environment. Maybe you dream of working with technology that makes a difference and are looking for a place where you can grow and take responsibility from day one.

To succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying a relevant degree within Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or similar

• Have an interest in embedded software and technological development

• Work in a structured way and can handle multiple tasks simultaneously

• Are a good communicator who thrives in collaboration across different levels of the organization

• Have a proactive mindset and get motivated by exploring new technologies, which requires new solutions and software development

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Details about the internship will be agreed upon individually. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

In case of questions regarding the position, please contact Functional Lead - Connectivity Technology, Lead Specialist, Jonas Drammestrup Poulsen, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

If you want your work to move beyond experimentation and into real-world implementation, this could be the right place for you.

You’ll join a team of specialists who live and breathe digital transformation, helping some of Denmark’s largest and most influential organizations turn data into action. Here, innovation isn’t a buzzword – it’s how we think, collaborate, and deliver.

About the Role

You will contribute directly to the design, development, and deployment of advanced data and AI systems in cloud-based environments.

Your responsibilities may include:

• Architecting and implementing end-to-end AI and machine learning solutions

• Deploying, monitoring, and optimizing models on cloud platforms

• Translating business requirements into structured technical solutions

• Ensuring solutions are maintainable, scalable, and aligned with best practices

Your Background

We are open to different experience levels, provided you bring strong fundamentals and practical experience.

Experience and Education

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience

• Experience with generative AI

• Analytical and structured in your problem-solving approach

• Comfortable operating in client-facing environments

• Able to communicate complex technical topics in business-relevant terms

• Pragmatic, quality-driven, and accountable for outcomes

What You Can Expect From Us

• Meaningful, technically challenging projects with real business visibility

• A strong professional environment with high standards and high trust

• Autonomy in how you structure and deliver your work

• Access to modern tooling, platforms, and certifications (including Microsoft)

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits

• Continuous development — technically and professionally

Let’s Talk

Send your CV or a short introduction to hr@venzo.com.

Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

**Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

• In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

• You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

• You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

• You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

• You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

• Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

**This includes things like...

**

• Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

• Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

• Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

• Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

• Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

**You’re a great match if

**

• You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

• You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

• You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

• You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

• You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

**Nice to haves

**

• You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

• Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

• Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

• Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

• Experience building systemic or open-world games

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**

• You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

• You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

• You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

• You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

• You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

**Practicalities

**

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• Our working language is English.

**We offer

**

• Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• Pension plan and private health insurance.

• Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

**Department: Novo Nordisk Clinical Innovation Centre A/S (CLINiC)

Location: Gentofte, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

Contribute to early-phase clinical research and phase I trials at CLINiC. As a Clinical Research Physician, you will combine clinical work with medical and scientific knowledge across trial setup and execution. Your expertise will support participant safety, robust decision-making and reliable data generation, while contributing to the development of potential new treatments in line with the Novo R&D strategy.

Introduction

Novo Nordisk Clinical Innovation Centre A/S (CLINiC) is an organisation dedicated to early-phase clinical trials assessing the safety and tolerability, pharmaco-kinetics and dynamics of potential new Novo medicines. In this role, you will combine hands-on clinical activities, medical oversight and trial leadership in an environment where participant safety, scientific quality and operational excellence are central.

What you’ll bring

We are looking for a physician with strong clinical judgement, experience in clinical research and a collaborative approach.

• A Medical Doctor (MD) degree and solid clinical experience; a PhD is an advantage.

• Experience in conducting clinical trials as a Principal Investigator or Sub-Investigator; experience with early-phase clinical trials is an advantage.

• Knowledge of ICH-GCP and relevant regulatory frameworks.

• Solid experience in managing acute medical emergencies.

• Strong collaboration, stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills in an international setting.

• Fluency in Danish for interaction with trial participants and strong English skills for internal collaboration.

You bring a proactive, quality-focused mindset and can navigate complexity while keeping participant safety and trial excellence at the center of your decisions.

What you’ll do

You will play a key role in delivering safe, high-quality early-phase clinical trials at CLINiC. Your essential work will include:

• Leading and conducting clinical trials, including protocol review, trial execution, medical oversight and informal leadership of trial teams.

• Acting as Principal Investigator or Sub-Investigator, with responsibility for participant safety, trial conduct and data integrity.

• Conducting screening, in-house, overnight and ambulatory visits. Shift work (on-call or on-site) will be part of the role according to trial activities.

• Providing medical and scientific expertise to stakeholders and supporting the training and development of colleagues.

• Driving risk assessments, management of protocol deviations and quality processes.

• Contributing actively to cross-functional initiatives, continuous improvement and the development of supporting IT systems.

Who you’ll work with

You will join CLINiC in Gentofte as part of our Operations team, working closely across clinical, scientific and operational disciplines to deliver high-quality data to the Sponsor organisation. You will also support colleagues through medical guidance, knowledge sharing and informal leadership of trial teams.

What you can expect here

At CLINiC, you can expect meaningful clinical work in a highly collaborative environment. You will contribute to an organisation focused on participant safety, scientific excellence and continuous improvement, with opportunities to develop through cross-functional collaboration.

Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 847,000 to DKK 1,245,100, corresponding to the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks. Benefits are designed with different career and life stages in mind.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy: https://www.novonordisk.com/careers/working-at-novo-nordisk/total-rewards-benefits.html

Apply now and bring your clinical expertise to work that can shape the earliest stages of medicine development.

jobs.description:
We are searching for a skilled and experienced post doc with specific interest in investigating early myeloid disease, clonal haematopoiesis, metabolism and obesity.

  Our research/The group

  The focus of the Grønbæk group is Translational Haematology. The group is affiliated with Biotech Research and Innovation centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen and Rigshospitalet (Central Copenhagen University Hospital). 

  Our overall aim is to understand the molecular mechanisms of haematological cancers and based on this; to design, develop and implement novel, scientifically based, clinical trials, with a strong focus on epigenetic therapies. This is done by bridging between clinical research at Rigshospitalet and the basic cancer biology research at BRIC, and in international collaborations with, among others, the Van Andel Research Institute, Michigan, USA and the Nordic MDS study group.

  Our location at the Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC provides optimal conditions for interaction with the basic scientists at BRIC. The group currently consists of 14 scientists, MD/scientists and students, one clinical research coordinator, 1 research nurse and 2 biomedical laboratory scientists.

   

  The project: Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms.

  The current position is part of a joint project ‘Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms’ together with Professor George Vassiliou, Cambridge Stem Cell Institute, University of Cambridge, United Kingdom funded by a ‘Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC)’ grant from the Novo Nordisk foundation, which supports collaborative research projects with the purpose ‘to reverse-translate clinical observations into mechanistic studies that will increase our understanding of how obesity impacts carcinogenesis’.

  Obesity is a global health issue linked to increased risk of cancer, including blood cancers such as myeloid neoplasms (MN). Many MN arise from clonal haematopoiesis (CH)—the abnormal expansion of blood stem cell clones carrying somatic mutations. Haematopoietic stem cells interact with bone marrow adipose tissue (BMAT), which increases with obesity, which may fuel CH growth and progression to MN. Epidemiological and genetic studies already suggest obesity accelerates CH, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear.

  This project integrates large-scale population data, clinical trials, and mechanistic mouse studies to investigate these links and explore preventive or therapeutic strategies.

   

  Your job

  The project focuses on translational analyses of live frozen human cells from patient bone marrow (BM)/(BMAT) and blood samples from completed and ongoing clinical trials. We are searching for a skilled post doc who is very interactive and enjoys collaborations with other scientists – including younger scientists and clinician scientists.

  Your tasks will include:

   	
• Process of live frozen patient material from clinical trials including isolation of defined cell populations, and quality control for downstream omics 	
• Perform in-house molecular techniques which may include Proteomics, PCR, ddPCR, and library/sample preparation for RNA-seq, ATAC-seq and DNA methylation analyses 	
• Coordinate genomic, transcriptomic, lipidomic, metabolomic analyses with our internal and external collaborating laboratories and take the lead on designing relevant sub-studies, integrating and interpreting the data 	
• Help establish the practical and regulatory framework for these collaborations, including material transfer and data-sharing agreements 	
• Participate in grant and manuscript writing 	
• Present at local and international meetings 	
• Introduce lab techniques to new lab members and students 	
• Collaborate with both scientists and clinicians   Start: February 1st, 2027

  Duration: 2 years

  Profile

  We expect you to be a highly motivated and highly ambitious, independent scientist with the following qualifications: •

   	
• A PhD in Life Sciences with a preferred focus on haematology 	
• A strong background in mechanisms of normal and malignant haematopoiesis and molecular haematology techniques 	
• Comprehensive lab skills in molecular and cellular biology techniques, including work with primary human cells and cryopreserved patient material 	
• Experience with genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, lipidomics, metabolomics and ability to analyse and interpret such data 	
• Experience with running projects across research groups 	
• Strong publication and presentation record in peer reviewed journals and international conferences 	
• Excellent written and spoken English skills 	
• Very collaborative 	
• Good social skills     

  Place of employment
 The workplace is at the Bartholin Institute which is part of Rigshospitalet, University of Copenhagen. The Bartholin Institute is located at Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC, close to the centre of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and a number of core facilities (animal unit, flow cytometry, in vivo imaging, NGS, etc.) shared between the research groups at BRIC (www.bric.ku.dk) and the neighbouring Finsen Laboratory. We have weekly journal clubs, data clubs, seminars with invited speakers and a young researchers club ASAP and our own PhD programme, MoMeD.

   

  Terms of employment 
 The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of two years. The starting date is 01.02.2027 or after agreement.
 Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 39,900 DKK/approx. 5,300 EUR (August 2026 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18,07 % to your pension fund.

  Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025

   

  Questions 

  For further information regarding the position, please contact Professor Kirsten Grønbæk, kirsten groenbaek@regionh.dk; phone + 4535456086 / +4525211598.

  Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

   

  Application
 The application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

  1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page).

  2. CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position.

  3. A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do.

  4. List of publications.

   

  Recommendation 
 Furthermore, the applicant should provide two letters of recommendation or two references. To be taken into consideration, the letters must be signed by the supporting person on paper with institutional letter head and in PDF-format.

Join us in this role where you have ownership of trading strategies across Continental European and UK power markets, generating value through fundamental and quantitative insights while contributing to the transition to a renewable energy future.

As a Senior Trader, you'll operate within a defined risk mandate, identify and capture opportunities across the power curve, and help shape the future direction of our discretionary and systematic trading strategies. You'll work at the intersection of market intelligence, analytics, and technology, combining deep market understanding with innovative trading approaches to deliver strong commercial results.

Welcome to Market Trading

You'll become part of Continental & UK Trading, where we generate value through trading across European power, carbon, and gas markets. The team combines experienced traders, analysts, quants, and developers, creating an environment where market insights, data-driven decision making, and innovation come together.

In this role, you'll focus on Continental European and UK power curve products, leveraging your understanding of market fundamentals, cross-commodity relationships, and risk dynamics to identify and execute profitable trading opportunities.

As a team, we're ambitious, collaborative, and highly performance-oriented. We challenge each other's thinking, share knowledge openly, and continuously adapt to changing market conditions. This creates an exciting environment for experienced traders looking to make an impact while continuing to develop professionally.

You’ll play an important role in:

• delivering strong trading performance across Continental and UK power markets within an allocated risk mandate

• developing and executing trading strategies across forward and futures markets, with a particular focus on curve products

• identifying market opportunities through analysis of power fundamentals, weather, cross-border flows, fuel markets, carbon pricing, and broader macroeconomic developments

• helping shape and enhance systematic trading capabilities by collaborating closely with quantitative analysts and algorithmic developers

• actively managing risk and ensuring disciplined position management under changing market conditions

• translating market developments into actionable trading decisions and commercial outcomes.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have significant experience trading European power markets, especially Continental European and/or UK markets

• have a proven track record of delivering results within a delegated trading mandate and managing risk effectively

• possess a strong understanding of power market fundamentals and the key drivers influencing curve valuations

• can develop clear market views and translate them into profitable trading strategies

• combine strong analytical and numerical capabilities with sound commercial judgement

• are comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where decisions must be made under uncertainty

• thrive in close collaboration with traders, analysts, quants, and developers

• communicate openly, challenge constructively, and contribute positively to a high-performing team culture.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

At Netcompany, we are looking for recent graduates with a bachelor’s degree who want a challenging, social and developing start to their career as an Associate Consultant. Are you excited by the opportunity to work on complex IT solutions that make a real impact, while combining hands-on development with project delivery and close client interaction?

Responsibilities & technologies

As an Associate Consultant at Netcompany, you will contribute to translating customer needs into the right technical solutions. Depending on the project and customer, you may become part of either our Application Services or Consulting business area. In both areas, you will work closely with exciting customers and colleagues to develop and deliver high-quality IT solutions. Your work will span different projects, technologies, and domains, giving you the opportunity to continuously expand your knowledge and expertise. We work with a wide range of technologies and platforms, such as .NET, C#, Java, React, Angular, Salesforce, Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe and more.

As an Associate Consultant, you will contribute to all aspects of system development with focus on technical tasks. Your tasks and responsibilities will vary from project to project and evolve over time, but your responsibilities will typically include:

• Development of frontend and backend features for customer solutions.

• Setup and development of frameworks, integrations, and extensions for standard platforms.

• Automation of business processes through, for example, batch jobs.

• Development of tools and scripts for data migration and other technical solutions.

About you

We expect you to hold a bachelor's degree or diploma in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you:

• Possess strong IT technical skills within object-oriented programming.

• Have fundamental knowledge of software development and are motivated to develop your competencies.

• Think analytically, show initiative, and work in a structured way.

Continue developing with us

The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

**About The Role

**As Commercial Manager you will help shape and execute the commercial agenda for some of 3Shape's strategically important businesses. Your mandate is to translate 3Shape strategies into scalable commercial programs that create value for customers, resellers, regional sales teams, and 3Shape.

The initial focus of the role is on our Laboratory business, with opportunities to expand the focus to other customer segments (Clinic & Enterprise) afterwards.

You will be a close commercial partner to regional teams and work across Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Customer Success, Finance, Operations, Sales Excellence, and Data & Analytics. The role combines commercial execution, program leadership, and operational excellence. You should be equally comfortable analyzing performance, developing a compelling commercial concept, aligning senior stakeholders, and rolling up your sleeves to operationalize it in the markets.

Your initial focus will be the Laboratory business and its indirect go-to-market model. You will connect partner strategy, end-customer opportunities, and frontline execution so that growth initiatives are grounded in data, converted into practical sales motions, and delivered with clear ownership and measurable impact.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Drive the reseller growth agenda by designing and implementing tangible, mutually beneficial commercial programs, including partner segmentation, growth plans, performance insights, incentives, enablement, and joint business planning.

• Own the commercial growth agenda for AI-powered Lab solutions, partnering across Regions, Product, Marketing, and Sales Excellence to accelerate adoption, maximize customer value realization, and develop AI into one of the largest and fastest-growing revenue streams within the business.

• Build a data-driven commercial agenda for Lab by translating customer, installed-base, pipeline, usage, renewal, and partner performance insights into prioritized growth opportunities and clear actions for regional and frontline teams.

• Develop and scale practical sales playbooks, value-selling materials, opportunity triggers, objection handling, and manager coaching tools that enable sales teams and resellers to identify, qualify, pursue, and convert growth opportunities.

• Conceptualize, test, and operationalize new commercial models, working across 3Shape to define the value proposition, partner economics, customer journey, governance, processes, and success metrics.

• Lead cross-functional commercial initiatives from problem definition through implementation, establishing clear workplans, decision points, ownership, adoption mechanisms, and measurable business outcomes.

• Act as a trusted business partner to regions and global functions, bringing market feedback into strategy, contributing to the rollout of our 2030 Lab Strategy, sharing best practices across markets, and ensuring that Lab priorities translate into consistent commercial execution.

**What we are looking for

**We recognize that strong candidates may have built relevant experience through different paths. For this role, we believe you will bring most of the following:

• Approximately 4+ years of experience in commercial strategy, management consulting, sales enablement, channel or partner management, commercial transformation, or another strategic commercial role.

• A strong commercial mindset with evidence of translating analysis and customer or market insight into actions that improve growth, conversion, productivity, retention, or partner performance.

• Experience working with indirect sales channels, resellers, distributors, partner programs, or B2B ecosystems. Experience in dental, medtech, software, or another complex solution business is an advantage, not a requirement.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to work confidently with commercial data, identify patterns, size opportunities, define KPIs, and turn insight into a clear recommendation.

• A track record of developing sales plays, commercial toolkits, business cases, or go-to-market programs and driving their adoption with frontline commercial teams.

• Strong project and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to create momentum across functions and regions through influence rather than formal authority.

• Clear, persuasive communication skills and the ability to move between executive-level recommendations and practical tools for salespeople and partners.

• A curious, pragmatic, and execution-oriented mindset. You bring structure to ambiguity, challenge constructively, and take ownership from concept through implementation.

**What 3Shape offers

**

• A vibrant and international environment with social, diverse, highly skilled, and collaborative colleagues. Our Denmark-based office includes more than 20 nationalities and colleagues from many different backgrounds.

• An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

• Breakfast every day, and delicious and healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.

• A strong social work environment with many optional activities and clubs, ranging from wine and beer, board games, and running to cycling.

• Good work/life balance.

• Attractive offices and R&D lab spaces in downtown Copenhagen, close to Kgs. Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.

• Our purpose: We empower dental professionals to provide superior care for every patient, every time.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

**About Us

**3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world.
